description: Canon §7 TestFlight set: jar knock — a tapped jar wobbles, and once in a great while comes off the belt (Gate A §8.4). LOCAL: fires on the viewer who tapped and never touches the shared schedule. `jar` arrives from the tap itself (trigger.inputs); how hard it rings AND whether it goes over are drawn from the shared seed at the tap second, so the response is local but its content is not a local dice roll.
